description: Tracked metadata manifest for seed-only sources used by the five-country geography pipeline.
policy: Raw seed files are stored in the gitignored seed/ directory and are NOT tracked in Git. This manifest is the only Git-tracked artifact that references them.
restore_command: Copy archived files from this manifest source to the seed/ directory before running the pipeline. Verify checksums with: sha256sum -c <(jq -r ".files[] | "\(.sha256)  \(.filename)"" SEED_MANIFEST.json)

files.seed_only_reason: Statistics Canada CSD cartographic boundary file has no stable public download URL; the page requires browser interaction.
files.restore_command: Download from the StatCan page or copy the archived file to the seed/ directory. Verify with sha256sum.

files.seed_only_reason: GB Countries FeatureServer output is not byte-stable across assemblies; archived file produced by a prior run with a working ArcGIS download endpoint.
files.restore_command: Download from the ArcGIS FeatureServer or copy the archived file to the seed/ directory. Verify with sha256sum.

files.seed_only_reason: ONS page requires interactive browser download; no stable direct URL available.
files.restore_command: Download from the ONS page or copy the archived file to the seed/ directory. Verify with sha256sum.

files.seed_only_reason: IE FeatureServer rejects geojson/query params with 400 Bad Request; archived file produced by a prior run using a working ArcGIS Online download endpoint.
files.restore_command: Download from the ArcGIS FeatureServer or copy the archived file to the seed/ directory. Verify with sha256sum.

files.seed_only_reason: CSO PxStat ReadDataset endpoint returns PX text format, not JSON; archived JSON produced by a prior run using the CSO API.
files.restore_command: Re-fetch via the CSO API or copy the archived file to the seed/ directory. Verify with sha256sum.

files.seed_only_reason: CSO PxStat endpoint returns PX text, not JSON; archived JSON produced by prior run.
files.restore_command: Re-fetch via the CSO API or copy the archived file to the seed/ directory. Verify with sha256sum.
